hooks.command: [ -n "$CLUE_ID" ] || exit 0; in=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.cwd'); root=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "$cwd"); printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r --arg r "$root" --arg id "$CLUE_ID" '[$r, $id, .session_id] | @tsv' >> "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/clue/sessions"
